packets.deliverable_and_acceptance: Surface upload/material/shader/exposure errors and resource residency/defer/fallback receipts. Deliberately missing/wrong-role resources must be diagnosable; never describe a neutral fallback as a fully textured surface.

Qualify colour transfer, linear/spectral interpretation, normal/tangent orientation, map packing and output transforms at agreed tolerances. Preserve semantic/spectral data; compare matched settings and expose unsupported profiles.

Qualify existing direct/environment lighting, shadows/bias, AO/contact and reflections on real surfaces and scale. Fix demonstrated faults; spectral/clustered/deferred source existence alone is not active-frame evidence.

Qualify leaf geometry or cards, two-sided normals/transmission, alpha coverage/mips, shadows and wind attachment. Check silhouettes and stability over distance; support the chosen representation before expanding foliage production.

Author native-editable bark/leaf/wood, fur/skin/eye, cloth, rock/soil, paint/metal/rubber/glass and water materials at target distances. Preserve real references/derivation; greater texture resolution cannot replace distinct surface response.

Qualify shallow/deep response, shoreline wetness, ordering/depth, reflections/refraction and motion in native scenes. Allocate additional fluid/optical capability only where the approved visual/physical target requires it.

Qualify high-grade master rendering and required film shading/groom/displacement/transparency, sampling/passes and designed cartoon treatment. Keep master fidelity independent of delivery resolution/device budget; specify missing operations explicitly. A film editor or merely high-poly mesh cannot establish the render path.

Review matched neutral and scene turntables/closeups plus moving light/camera on actual runtime outputs. Resolve clipping, washed-out detail, seams, aliasing and inconsistent surfaces; bind approval to settings/artifacts and target.

Select identified tree/understorey and animal reference species; assemble diagnostic references, scale/anatomy/lifecycle/repertoire inventory and rights. Unknowns/conflicts remain explicit; species labels cannot stand in for modeled diagnostic traits.

Build the hero tree's root flare/taper/unions, branching/twigs, crown gaps, characteristic asymmetry and species-specific leaf-bearing structure. Retain editable/procedural sources; remove near-view opaque crown substitutes and misplaced oversized leaves.
Finish leaves, bark/wood, reproductive organs, tissue transitions and per-part surfaces/UVs. Review unlabelled silhouette and neutral-light trunk/leaf/flower/fruit closeups at each approved scale.

Produce evidenced age/season/health/growth/reproductive variants, shrubs/grass/sedges, litter/deadwood and species-specific diversity. Changes must affect meaningful structure and habitat use, not just palette/modulo archetype choice.

Build the hero animal's coherent skull/muzzle/ears, trunk/pelvis/limb/feet/tail anatomy, deformation topology and part hierarchy. Confirm scale and unlabelled species recognition; generic capsules remain blockouts until reviewed.

Finish coat/groom/eyes/nose/claws and coherent skin/muscle/bone/organ depictions appropriate to the species. Validate alignment, diagnostic differences and tissue surfaces; exploded views must start from a coherent intact body.

Produce declared organ/tissue/cellular/molecular or other supported scale representations with evidence, units and epistemic status. Do not claim cell/organ fidelity from a differently sized primitive or label.

Link whole/part/scale representations and graph annotations, accurate cuts/explodes and compatible LODs. Picking/labels highlight the actual identified structure and preserve state across representation changes.

Apply equivalent dossiers to every scoped flora/fauna/funga/microbial subject and knowledge partition. Preserve full available corpus/provenance, non-visual facts and relations; record explicit production backlog and missing evidence by entity.

Verify declared reference species masters and their film/game/cartoon forms for diagnostic truth, form/material/motion quality, uncertainty and full graph/resources. Compare derivative preservation with the accepted source; record scientific and visual review separately. Counts, labels and illustrative images cannot close these cases.

Census vehicles, trailers, structures, tools and infrastructure from actual scope and reference scenes. Select vehicle and workshop/site-system reference assemblies; record engineered versus illustrative design, dimensions, provenance and operating assumptions.

Produce editable vehicle/trailer assemblies with correct proportions, bevels, glazing/interior as scoped, wheels/tyres/suspension, lights, doors and service parts. Separate material/part IDs and review contact, articulation and closeups.

Produce workshop/building/site assemblies with structure/envelope/openings, joints, accessible spaces, interiors and services at required detail. Preserve dimensions/BOM/as-built distinctions and editable source, not only an exterior shell.

Define ports, installation, constraints, utilities, storage and resource/energy/material flows between assemblies. Test incompatible connections, capacities, insufficient inputs and stale observations without conflating graph assertions with working simulation.

Produce scoped solar/storage/charging, water filtration, hydroponics/reed beds, nursery, maker/repair/library equipment and other scene things. Each gets its own design/instance/part/operation dossier and all required quality profiles.

Author reference people with credible proportions, hands/feet/face, clothing/equipment and appropriate representation rights. Keep human identifiers/authority distinct from owned scene props and use approved reference/provenance.

Finish face/skin/eyes/hair/cloth/equipment materials, deformation sources and required film/game/cartoon depictions. Review silhouette, expression and closeup deformation with explicit target/style criteria.

Specify operation, failure, damage, repair, replaceable parts, maintenance, wear and history for things/systems. Preserve design versus observed instance state and govern resource changes; decorative animation does not prove operation.

Derive game LODs/collision/occluders and other film/cartoon depictions from accepted high-grade assemblies or approved shared sources, preserving semantic parts/ports/function. Record source/output identifiers, measured loss, scale/topology/UV criteria and intended-shot visual review. Keep masters editable and unchanged by reduction.

Review complete reference artefact/human dossiers across declared targets with credible assembly, materials, articulation and scope-appropriate functional evidence. Record unavailable/incomplete cases rather than approving by screenshot alone.

Inventory every applicable clip/action, state, transition, contact, lifecycle stage, interaction and variant/rig/profile compatibility. Define observable movement/behaviour scenarios including abort/interruption/failure; unknown repertoire remains open.

Author skin/morph/constraints and full scoped animal repertoire: breathing/idle, locomotion/speeds/turns, feeding, resting, grooming, reproduction/parental/defensive actions as applicable. Validate balance, foot/tail contact, secondary motion and transitions.

Author supported wind/branch/leaf response, growth/phenology, flowering/fruit/seed and damage/recovery states. Separate scientifically evidenced dynamics from illustrative motion; preserve attachment, tissue/part continuity and time units.

Author human locomotion/handling/tool-use, vehicle steering/suspension/doors and machine operation appropriate to scope. Validate reach/grips, sit/stand/enter/exit, contacts and interruption across required rigs/profiles.

Implement shared governed state/action orchestration with sensed conditions, ecological/social/functional interactions and lawful authority. Distinguish canned clip presentation from behaviour decisions and authoritative simulated state.

Qualify existing world transforms, collision, ground contact, root motion, IK and relevant dynamics on real models. Replace per-frame monolithic rebuilds with supported instances/updates; extend solver APIs only for demonstrated requirements.

Inventory and author calls, environmental/operating sounds, foley, event timing, loops, variations and rights. Qualify editable sources and audible playback; headless transport success alone cannot prove an audio engine.

Qualify required vehicle/ground/water/plant/system coupling, loads, constraints and resource flows with units/bounds. Keep observation, prediction and illustrative effects distinct; document unsupported realism rather than inventing telemetry.

Qualify positional audio, emitter/listener movement, attenuation/occlusion, mixing and audiovisual timing through existing capabilities. Include missing-device, cancellation and reduced-sensory/accessibility behaviour.

Review every expanded required action/transition/interaction/profile case in continuous runtime sequences. Reject sliding, interpenetration, stale bounds/normals, broken contacts and ungrounded sound; record human/domain review and exact remaining cases.

Unify physical units, coordinate/geospatial frames, per-site origin, camera/movement and actor scale. Verify distances and bounds end to end; remove unexplained scale multipliers and inconsistent normalisation.

Author a high-grade place master from identified terrain/hydro/routes/structures/ecology references, or declare an illustrative/fictional composition. Qualify recognisable distinguishing features and scale before deriving consumer resources; a generic analytic valley and regional label cannot satisfy a real-place case.

Compose foreground/middle/backdrop, paths, shore transitions, rocks, ground materials, litter and understorey with ecological placement. Review density, silhouette rhythm, grounding and subject visibility at walk and overview distances.

Compose the high-grade place and people-led civics case: baseline problem, needs/resources, possible responses/tradeoffs/opportunities and observable consequences. Distinguish government civic roles and actual paid/unpaid contributions. Where cooperative use is in scope, demonstrate bounded commercial cost recovery and permitted human-rights no-charge treatment through existing policies.

Populate the place with identified high-grade subjects and approved delivery representations, ecologically and functionally appropriate placement and meaningful variants. Verify scale/material/behaviour continuity and scenario readability; graph catalogue size cannot establish rendered diversity or coherent place identifiers.

Fit camera/composition to whole tree, stem, leaf, reproductive organ and microscopic views. Provide truthful cuts/explodes, scale bars and anchored highlights; preserve subject identifiers and avoid clipping beneath UI.

Present coherent intact animal first, with readable deliberate tissue layers/sections and species-specific anatomy. Fit each state to the viewport and distinguish illustrated anatomy from validated scientific structure.

Make Poet/viewer content prominent with collapsible responsive controls, keyboard/focus, readable labels, reduced motion and accessible selection. World/lab state must switch cleanly; labels must resolve to visible identified structures.

Route selection, cuts/sliders, camera and transforms through shared commands/state and incremental jobs. Avoid full world/mesh generation for a highlight or orbit; qualify cancellation/stale results and measured interactive responsiveness. VIBE-05/06 qualify bounded script scheduling, clocked updates, safe reload and host jobs rather than duplicate JS state or per-interaction builds.

Review high-grade place/master views and actual game-demo derivatives across overview/walk/closeup/lab and supported viewports. Users must recognise subjects/context, inspect linked knowledge, understand the bounded civics case and reach Poet editing/scenario alternatives with preserved identifiers. Bind visual/domain/UX acceptance to actual artifacts.

Set per-target budgets for startup/decode/upload/first present, interaction and steady frame-time distribution, memory/allocations/streaming and power where relevant. Record device/display/settings and distinguish measurements from targets.
Measure active scene instance, skin/morph, culling, LOD, draw and update paths with reviewed content. Optimize identified bottlenecks, not proxy counts; include populated scenes and camera movement.

Qualify graph/resource working sets, async decode/upload, prefetch, eviction, bounded queues and cancellation during traversal. Verify HMC integrity/rights and complete-package identifiers survive partial residency.

Qualify reproducible master-to-device LOD/texture/rig and selected representation derivations using measured error plus required semantic/functional preservation. Compare silhouettes, materials, wind/motion, picks and scenario clues in intended shots; preserve master sources and report targets whose budgets cannot meet acceptance.

Stress corrupt/missing inputs, device/resource loss, out-of-budget load, suspend/resume and long sessions. Retain admitted content/work, release resources and expose useful failures; no fabricated readiness or completion.

Qualify supported native backends/hardware/display scales with the actual Aether/Etalon/Qualia path and dependency profile. Record unsupported hardware and scoped fallback limitations without introducing a required JS/V8 substitute.

Qualify supported browser/WASM-local/native-assisted modes with exact artifact, binding, origin/isolation, worker/transport, adapter and native provider requirements. A native capture cannot prove browser behaviour.

Exercise provider loss/revocation, tab/window closure, cancellation, service restart, reconnect and audio/device interruptions with pending edits/jobs. Verify state reconciliation and no duplicate side effects or leaked work.

Qualify crowded habitats, large assemblies/corpora, concurrent editing/jobs and long-duration traversal. Preserve reference visual/scientific criteria while meeting declared budgets; record capacity limits and controlled degradation.

Produce a target/version evidence matrix of correctness, visual quality, latency/resource budgets and recovery. Link regressions to content/path/dependency changes and retain valid prior results; avoid repeated broad tests without cause.

Implement authoritative native claim/evidence/review and project/finance/QDNF linkage. Retain unit-qualified valuation, contribution/pool IDs, operative agreements/instruments, provider allocations, periods, receipts, no-charge/waiver/discharge and residual states separately. Reuse capped owners and history; exported JSON/instructions do not enforce runtime accounting. AGR-03/05/06/11; FUND-02/03.

Enforce deliverable/case/authority/evidence coverage and native unit-safe agreement/compensation/credit rules. Qualify commercial/human-rights, partial/final/zero-cost/gifted, cap/duplicate/reversal, funded drawdown/no-overdraft, period rollover, residual return/delegation and malformed/stale/token/unsupported-rail cases. No false adoption, assent, payment or human review. AGR-03/05–07/11; FUND-02–06. VIBE-11 adds exact language/profile requirement and case claims; docs, fixture counts or version constants cannot certify operational completion.

Bind package/task release checks to content IDs and external receipts without circular hashes. Qualify native admission and actual agreement/credit/obligation/settlement evidence, preserving private source records and prior claims. Missing/invalid cases return incomplete; fixtures and in-process results cannot certify external transfers. AGR-05/06/09/11; FUND-03/04.

Review selected high-grade reference subjects/place and required derivatives against all expanded catalogue and added master/lineage/place/scenario/experience cases. Film/game/cartoon, full knowledge/sources, motion/media and operational scope must pass independently; list every remaining ID and actual consumer-use evidence.

Prepare native high-grade masters and reviewed derivatives with complete HMCs, editable sources, notices, attribution, operative terms and contribution/pool/allocation lineage as applicable. Preserve exact master/output/runtime IDs and source rights. Bind actual adopted agreements and verified events; reduced exports declare coverage. AGR-09/11.

Qualify actual game-demo civics use and Webizen/Poet native/WASM continuity, including relevant instrument/project funding/period/usage/residual cases and recovery. Record local/assisted operation and real provider/rail status; unavailable live settlement cannot be relabelled completed. Publication and real financial actions remain separately allocated. AGR-08–11; FUND-06. VIBE-08/11 preserve explicit native/WASM language semantics, grants, source/live-edit/job state and disconnect/rejoin evidence.

Turn accepted families and native workflows into reproducible authoring recipes and review examples. Expand the model/species/thing census in bounded batches; every item retains its full dossier and three profiles.

Automate repetitive native source/derive/validate/review preparation through qualified Vibe/Poet/Craft interfaces. Preserve artist control, provenance and human judgments; procedural generation alone cannot auto-approve output quality.

Define change-impact/requalification for graph/models/tools, agreements/instruments, valuation policy, period/allocation grants and settlement events. Preserve originating contributions, unused provider funds, legitimate outstanding costs, discharged ancestors and auditable corrections through restart, policy, derivative/adoption and provider changes. AGR-06/09/11; FUND-03/04.

Review scoped master/derivative/platform and civics/Webizen outcomes with preserved authorship and paid/unpaid history. Demonstrate a useful SDGs-work agreement/instrument case, fair valuation, bounded commercial/no-charge treatment and provider-directed funded allocations/period residuals. Report exact passed/open scope; do not certify exploitation eradicated or payments made from source/fixtures alone. AGR-10/11; FUND-06. VIBE-11 requires explicit compatible source migration and actually qualified language/profile release evidence; optional bytecode work cannot block unrelated first-output cases.
